objective.name: Change the training objective
objective.summary: Pointwise BCE optimises a different thing from a within-user ranking metric. Pairwise (BPR) or listwise (softmax over the user's list) targets the metric directly.
notes: The organizers rank this their most likely direction. Untested here.

sequence.name: User behaviour sequences / target attention
sequence.summary: No behaviour sequence is used at all. DIN/SIM-style interest modelling over the user history is unexplored.
notes: Check history_coverage first: attention needs the candidate or its author to actually appear in the user history.

multitask.name: Multi-task auxiliary heads
multitask.summary: is_click, is_like, play_time_ms and others are available as auxiliary targets while long_view stays the scored task.
notes: Reach them with harness.adapter.auxiliary_targets(). Never same-row inputs.

watchtime.name: Censored watch-time regression
watchtime.summary: A completed play truncates true watch time, so a one-sided loss rather than squared error.
notes: Needs play_time_ms and duration_ms via the adapter.

model_family.name: Different model family
model_family.summary: DeepFM / DCN / xDeepFM / GBDT over engineered features.
notes: The organizers deprioritise this because capacity measurably is not the bottleneck — see the capacity dead end.

temporal.name: Time features and drift
temporal.summary: hourmin, date, and the train-to-validation regime change.
notes: Daily volume collapses 13.6x INSIDE the training window (4/11 peak, 4/19 trough), not at the train/validation boundary.

debias.name: Exposure debiasing / unbiased validation
debias.summary: The random-exposure log as an unbiased check on a model fitted to biased traffic.
notes: is_rand is 0 on every standard-log row, so it carries no propensity signal there. The random log has no rows before 20220422.

ensembling.name: Variance reduction / ensembling
ensembling.summary: Combine several models' within-user ranks to cancel seed variance.
notes: Five identity seeds give a validation population std of 0.00032.

static_features.name: Add more static categorical fields
static_features.summary: Extending the FM from 5 fields to the 13 CWM fields.
notes: Organizer-published. Within noise and slightly worse. Reproducible via ablation_features.py — do not run it, it scores test.

capacity.name: Increase embedding dimension
capacity.summary: Larger k for the factorization machine.
notes: Organizer-published. Capacity is not the bottleneck; 1.14M rows do not support more of it.

user_side_first_order.name: Pure user-side first-order features
user_side_first_order.summary: A user-level feature added as an additive term.
notes: Ranking is within-user, so any term constant across a user's impressions cannot change that user's order. Contributes exactly zero. User information can only act through a cross with the item side.

score_transform.name: Per-user monotone score transforms
score_transform.summary: Calibration, sigmoid, per-user normalisation at inference.
notes: Both GAUC and nDCG@5 depend only on within-user order, which a monotone transform preserves. Exactly zero effect.
